fields.v: Tasks: SWE-bench Lite (300) + CTXBENCH (138; LLM-generated task descriptions and tests, manually reviewed). Configurations: 4 agent+model pairs x {None, LLM, DEV}; DEV only on CTXBENCH (20 cells) + ablations. Baseline: None. Held constant: default agent settings, temperature (0 for Sonnet/GPT, 0.7 for Qwen), task, Docker image, git history removed, web access allowed; Claude Code kept the Task tool enabled, so Sonnet-4.5 also invoked Haiku-4.5 sub-agents. Acceptance tests: hidden tests (75% coverage; 25/138 edited). Repetitions: 1 (sampled once). Human intervention: none during runs; manual cheating check after
fields.quote: For CLAUDE CODE, we keep the Task tool enabled: it allows SONNET-4.5 to invoke sub-agents, using HAIKU-4.5, to solve sub-tasks.
fields.why: The Claude Code configuration also used Haiku-4.5 sub-agents, so the model is not only Sonnet-4.5; the design field does not record this.
fields.doubt: Na pág. 13 os autores dizem que o Claude Code usou sub-agentes com Haiku-4.5, além do Sonnet-4.5. Como o modelo é uma variável, vê se queres registar isto no desenho da comparação (ou nas Notas).
